intelligence.human_view: This is the shape of the day itself. Today the day's things live in separate places — the journal somewhere, the notes somewhere, the posts somewhere, the news somewhere, the work somewhere — and the citizen has to go find each one. Shawn's picture is one room per day: you go in and there is the visual timeline, and everything that day holds is already there — the journal, the Naya Notes, the posts, the smart notes, the intelligence, the news feeds, the world, the work, the personal life, all in one place. The + button stops being a generic add and becomes add-journal — write for that day, it is saved, everything you noted for that day stays, and you can go back on days. The calendar click already moves day to day; the viewer makes it a scroll, one day flowing into the next. And the feeling is the standard, not the decoration: high high level luxury spaces, absolutely epic worlds people walk into or click into — push-button simple, boom into the next one. A day that feels like a luxury world you walk into is a day a citizen wants to come back to. That is why the day is one place, and why the feeling is named in the same breath as the structure: the structure is where everything lives, the feeling is why anyone opens the door. It rides with the day-view work: v15 passed all items 17:34Z, and this dictation is what the day view grows into next — the calendar as the door, the day as the room.
intelligence.simple_view: Your whole day lives in ONE room! Your journal, your notes, your posts, your smart notes, your news, your world, your work — everything for that day, all together! Tap the + button and write in your journal for that day — it saves all by itself! And you can scroll from one day to the next, like walking from one beautiful room into the next one — boom!
